help.name: help
help.description: Display list of commands and usage guide
help.title: 🦆 QuackMuzik - Command List
help.description_full:
Simple music bot with Lavalink

Use `{prefix}help <command name>` to see details

prefix.name: prefix
prefix.description: View or change bot prefix for this server
prefix.current_description: Bot prefix for this server is: `{prefix}`
prefix.updated_description: New bot prefix for this server is: `{prefix}`
prefix.no_permission: ❌ You need **Manage Server** permission to use this command!
prefix.guild_only: ❌ This command can only be used in a server!
prefix.error: ❌ An error occurred while updating prefix!

play.name: play
play.description: Play music from link or search on YouTube
play.no_query:
❌ Please provide a link or search keywords!
Example: `{prefix}play never gonna give you up`
play.no_voice: ❌ You must be in a voice channel to play music!
play.error: ❌ An error occurred while playing music!
play.error_tip: 💡 Try again or use a different link.

queue.name: queue
queue.description: Display list of songs in queue
queue.title: 🎶 Queue - {guild}

nowplaying.name: nowplaying
nowplaying.description: Display currently playing song with progress bar
nowplaying.title: 🎵 Now Playing
nowplaying.author: 👤 Author

stop.name: stop
stop.description: Stop playing music and clear queue

skip.name: skip
skip.no_voice: ❌ You must be in a voice channel to use this command!
skip.same_voice_channel: ❌ You must be in the same voice channel as the bot!
skip.skipped_last:
⏭️ Skipped: **{title}**
✅ End of queue, stopped playing.
skip.error: ❌ An error occurred while skipping the song!

jump.name: jump
jump.description: Jump to a specific song in queue
jump.no_voice: ❌ You must be in a voice channel to use this command!
jump.same_voice_channel: ❌ You must be in the same voice channel as the bot!
jump.no_position:
❌ Please provide a position number!
Example: `{prefix}jump 5`
jump.invalid_number: ❌ Invalid position number! Please enter a number greater than 0.
jump.out_of_range: ❌ Position exceeds queue length! Queue currently has {count} songs.
jump.error: ❌ An error occurred while jumping to the song!

seek.name: seek
seek.description: Seek to a specific position in the song
seek.no_voice: ❌ You must be in a voice channel to use this command!
seek.same_voice_channel: ❌ You must be in the same voice channel as the bot!
seek.no_time:
❌ Please provide a time!
Examples:
- `{prefix}seek 1:30` (1 minute 30 seconds)
- `{prefix}seek 90` (90 seconds)
- `{prefix}seek 2:15:30` (2 hours 15 minutes 30 seconds)
seek.invalid_format: ❌ Invalid time format! Use format: `1:30` or `90s`
seek.invalid_negative: ❌ Invalid time! Please enter a value greater than 0.
seek.out_of_range:
❌ Time exceeds song duration!
Song duration: {duration}
seek.not_seekable: ❌ This song does not support seeking (may be a livestream)!
seek.error:
❌ An error occurred while seeking!
💡 Make sure the time format is correct: `1:30` or `90`

speak.name: speak
speak.no_text: ❌ Please provide text to speak. Example: `{prefix}speak Hello everyone!`
speak.no_voice: ❌ You must be in a voice channel to use this command!
speak.same_voice_channel: ❌ You must be in the same voice channel as the bot to use this command!
speak.not_found: ❌ Could not load audio from FloweryTTS.

debug.name: debug
debug.description: [DEBUG] Display detailed information about player state
debug.title: 🔍 Debug Information
debug.description_full: Detailed information about player and queue
debug.no_player: ❌ No player is active in this server!
debug.owner_only: ❌ Only bot owner can use this command!

guilds.name: guilds
guilds.description: Display information about number of guilds bot is in
guilds.title: 📊 Guild Information
guilds.description_full: Statistics about servers bot is participating in
guilds.no_guilds: ❌ Bot is not in any guilds yet!
guilds.error: ❌ An error occurred while fetching guild information!

locale.name: locale
locale.description: View or change bot display language for this server
locale.current_description: Bot display language for this server is: {locale} (code: `{code}`)
locale.change_value:
Use `{prefix}locale <language code>` to change language
Example: `{prefix}locale vi` to switch to Vietnamese
locale.updated_description: New bot display language for this server is: {locale} (code: `{code}`)
locale.no_permission: ❌ You need **Manage Server** permission to use this command!
locale.guild_only: ❌ This command can only be used in a server!
locale.invalid: ❌ Language `{code}` is invalid! Valid language codes: `{valid}`
locale.already_set: ❌ This server is already using this language!
locale.error: ❌ An error occurred while updating language!

terms.name: terms
terms.description: View or accept Terms of Service
terms.title: 📜 Terms of Service
terms.description: By using this bot, you agree to comply with our Terms of Service. Please read and accept the terms to continue using the bot.
terms.status_accepted:
✅ **This server has accepted the Terms of Service.**
You can use all bot commands.
terms.status_not_accepted:
⚠️ **This server has not accepted the Terms of Service yet.**
You must accept the terms before using bot commands.
terms.accept_instruction:
A server administrator with **Manage Server** permission can accept the terms by using:
`{prefix}terms accept`
terms.full_terms_link: Read the complete Terms of Service: [GitHub Pages](https://eliitme.github.io/quackmuzik/terms.html)
terms.accepted_description: This server has successfully accepted the Terms of Service. You can now use all bot commands.
terms.already_accepted: ✅ This server has already accepted the Terms of Service.
terms.no_permission: ❌ You need **Manage Server** permission to accept the Terms of Service!
terms.error: ❌ An error occurred while accepting the Terms of Service!

playlist.no_subcommand:

Example: `{prefix}playlist create My Playlist`

create.error: ❌ An error occurred while creating playlist!

list.title: 📋 Your Playlists
list.empty:
❌ You don't have any playlists yet!
Create a new playlist: `{prefix}playlist create <name>`

add.no_query: ❌ Please provide a link or search keywords!
add.error: ❌ An error occurred while adding to playlist!

remove.no_playlist:

play.no_playlist:
